description: Defines trust levels and trust store interface for handling certificate trust in network security, including trust types, trust trustworthiness, and trust store methods.

classes.name: CertificateTrust
classes.description: Represents the trust level and constraints for a certificate, with methods to create specific trust states and evaluate trust properties.

classes.name: TrustStore
classes.description: Interface for managing and querying trusted certificates and trust anchors.

methods.name: ForTrustAnchor
methods.description: Creates a CertificateTrust object representing a trust anchor.

methods.name: ForTrustAnchorOrLeaf
methods.description: Creates a CertificateTrust object representing a trust anchor or leaf.

methods.name: ForTrustedLeaf
methods.description: Creates a CertificateTrust object representing a trusted leaf.

methods.name: ForUnspecified
methods.description: Creates a CertificateTrust object with unspecified trust.

methods.name: ForDistrusted
methods.description: Creates a CertificateTrust object representing a distrusted certificate.

methods.name: WithEnforceAnchorExpiry
methods.description: Sets whether to enforce anchor expiry constraints.

methods.name: WithEnforceAnchorConstraints
methods.description: Sets whether to enforce anchor constraints.

methods.name: WithRequireAnchorBasicConstraints
methods.description: Sets whether to require basic constraints on trust anchors.

methods.name: WithRequireLeafSelfSigned
methods.description: Sets whether to require trusted leaves to be self-signed.

methods.name: GetTrust
methods.description: Returns the trust level of a given certificate.

methods.name: AsyncGetIssuersOf
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves issuer certificates for a given certificate.
